seed: Byron's facilitation note: Leadership Time Assessment. Rollout chart ruling, 26 October and 16 November 2026.

slides.title: Where does your time go?
slides.headline: Where does your time go?
slides.support: What percentage of your time goes to each category? Your four numbers total 100%.
notes: Each leader enters their current allocation. Record how the time is really spent, not an ideal split.
Then talk about what the allocations show. The founder compares with the baseline from the call before Q1.
Keep the completed assessment. The next review compares against it.
When the leadership team is the whole company, skip this slide and ask the owner privately.

artwork.alt: One neutral grey figure, hand on chin, studies a circle divided into four unequal slices: one green, one blue and two grey.
